references.text: Prohibition against temple prostitution among the daughters and sons of Israel, and a ban on bringing the wages of a prostitute to the house of the Lord
Concerns the shame and dishonor brought upon a father's house through sexual immorality
A priest's daughter who commits prostitution dishonors her father and shall be punished by burning
Priests must not marry a prostitute or a dishonored woman
Hosea prophesies about daughters who commit prostitution and daughters-in-law who commit adultery, and the moral decay of the land
Jeremiah accuses the people that the land is filled with prostitution and godlessness
The people's unfaithfulness and visits to prostitutes lead to the corruption of the land
Ezekiel describes Jerusalem as a prostitute who dishonors herself
Israel begins to commit prostitution with the daughters of Moab, which leads to idolatry
Warning against the prostitute who leads a man to poverty and destruction
